title: Whitley Strieber: chosen as a disclosure node because he was a horror writer

tellings.quote: Whitley Streber talks about this as well where he says I think they chose me as a communication node for disclosure

plain: The idea here is that the horror writer Whitley Strieber, author of Communion, a book about his own reported encounters with non-human beings, was picked by those beings to help bring their existence into the open because he wrote horror. Michels raises it himself and says Strieber has said the same, quoting him as saying "I think they chose me as a communication node for disclosure", disclosure being the public revealing of what is known about UFOs. If that were true, the encounters would be a deliberate message sent to the public through a writer.
